diagnosis: Check C1, which is supposed to depend on the hidden infusion rate and gravity restriction in PF1, passed in all rollouts despite the lone decision-maker having no access to PF1. The model correctly assigned the pump to North based on shared facts (S1-S4), making C1 satisfiable through generic equipment assignment logic rather than the specific details of PF1.

C1.why: The exact 42 mL-per-hour continuous infusion and the fact that North cannot use gravity change the pump assignment to North and set the pump rate to exactly 42.
